Six things holding you back on Google

We read your homepage the way Google does. None of these is hard to fix, and none of them is about speed.

  • 1

    Your award isn’t on your website

    Your Facebook says you won Best Carpet Cleaning in the 2026 San Diego Union-Tribune Readers’ Poll. Your homepage doesn’t mention it anywhere.

  • 2

    The headline is just your name

    The main heading reads “Advanced Steam Cleaning.” It never says carpet cleaning or San Diego, the words people actually search.

  • 3

    One sentence, four times

    “We are committed as professional carpet cleaners…” is repeated four times on the homepage. Google reads that as thin, copied content.

  • 4

    Typos in the first screen

    “Services We Offered”, “We also off services” and “Pre-vaccum” are on the homepage. Customers notice.

  • 5

    No Google description

    The homepage has no summary for Google to show under your link, so Google picks its own text.

  • 6

    26 of 41 images Google can’t read

    Most homepage images have no description (alt text), so Google can’t tell what they show and screen readers skip them.

Lead with the award

Best Carpet Cleaning, 2026 Union-Tribune Readers’ Poll. None of the top four on Maps can say that. It belongs in the first line.

Say what you do and where, once

One clear headline, “San Diego carpet cleaning, voted best of 2026”, instead of one sentence repeated four times.

Show the reviews you mention

The homepage says “We have a 5 Star Rating On Google!!” but shows none of the 170 reviews. Put real quotes on the page.

Retire the 2022 copy

The footer still says © 2022 and the mission statement talks about Covid-19 protocols. Fresh copy tells customers, and Google, you’re busy now.

Website article

Which steam clean does your carpet need? Level 1, Advanced Steam Clean: regular upkeep. Pre-vacuum, pre-spray, surface scrub and a 500 PSI steam rinse. Level 2, Deep Scrub: high-traffic lanes and kids. Adds deep-penetrating agitation to lift grit from the base of the fibers. Level 3, For Health: pets, allergies or a new baby. Adds bio-cide, citrus and enzyme treatments. Not sure? Call (619) 394-5002 and we’ll tell you honestly.
